comparability.geometry_evidence: Same positions declared in the free-movement plan; no measured coordinates, controlled geometry or camera proof.

sentado.movement: Sentado frente a la laptop; permanecerá quieto durante la prueba.
sentado.geometry: Un receptor a cada lado del operador. TX-01 a algo más de 2 metros; distancia aproximada declarada, sin medida exacta. No se asigna izquierda/derecha a identidades USB.
sentado.tx_power: TX-01 alimentado por cargador USB conectado a la pared. RX-01 y RX-02 conectados por USB a la laptop.

libre.condition: una persona presente, movimiento libre; sesión exploratoria
libre.occupancy: Una sola persona dentro de su cuarto: el operador.
libre.movement: Movimiento libre haciendo tareas normales. Declaración actual: comenzará inmediatamente DESPUÉS de enviar la autorización y mantendrá actividades hasta confirmación de ambos puertos cerrados. Inicio exacto no observado ni conocido; no se asume movimiento al enviar la autorización.
libre.geometry: Laptop, TX-01, RX-01, RX-02 y cables permanecerán en las mismas posiciones según declaración actual; no se registran medidas nuevas ni se asignan lados a las identidades USB.
libre.tx_power: TX-01 alimentado por cargador de pared. Ambos RX continúan conectados por USB a la laptop.

reconnection_history_sitting.operator_statement: Mientras esperaba que se renovaran los créditos de Codex, desconecté las placas y después las conecté nuevamente. No tengo registrada la hora exacta.
reconnection_history_sitting.which_boards_evidence: not specified; do not infer TX-01, RX-01 or RX-02 individually
reconnection_history_sitting.reason: All current RX identities/permissions are rechecked by metadata; the mandatory prospective READY criterion and its timeout do not depend on assigning the earlier reconnection to boards.

activity_transition_free_movement.evidence: operator declaration; transition not instrumentally observed
activity_transition_free_movement.relationship_declared: Activities begin immediately AFTER sending authorization, not already underway at message send.
activity_transition_free_movement.maintain_until: assistant confirms attempt finished and both ports closed
activity_transition_free_movement.planned_condition: una persona presente, movimiento libre; sesión exploratoria
activity_transition_free_movement.label_limitation: Exact physical transition and uninterrupted movement are not measured; do not infer them from CSI.

method.window: Original audited [T0,T1), first_read>=T0 and LF_return<T1; no new interval.
method.amplitude: hypot(Re,Im), raw int8 scale, uncalibrated; no normalization or dB transform.
method.mask: Fixed nominal data+pilot set (LLTF 52, HT-LTF 56) and original hardware/CFR mask. DC/guards excluded; valid zero amplitudes retained.
method.row_mean: Equal weight per active tone; NA if any required tone invalid. Row stays in original window.
method.variability: Population std per tone across its actual valid rows; separately std of per-row spatial means.
method.sampling: Equal row weights; no interpolation, imputation, resampling, bin selection or duration weighting.
method.plotting: Scatter at actual host LF times relative to each original T0; common axes per metric; no lines across missing time.
method.uncertainty: No p-values, confidence intervals or accuracy; frames are not independent session replicates.
method.scope: Separate session/RX/LTF; RSSI belongs to each row, not duplicated as independent LTF evidence.
